title: Kowloon Rising Anew
author: Marguerite Amberdale
blurb: Hazel Ashgrove, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
